method: view_image full source and generation JSON; independent Pillow alpha64 border/bounds and motherRGBA comparison.
observations: Exactly three recognisable beveled gold stars and a single shallow oval orbit retain dizziness/stun meaning.
No long body-height spiral, face, character or solid column. The wide short silhouette is materially better suited to overhead status placement than the original full-body spiral that obscured torso.
Actual alpha background exists, and no strong-alpha content contacts canvas border. No arbitrary prompt margin percentage is imposed as a formal source gate.
Warm glow around the orbit remains broad relative to the sharp line. At tiny display size it could merge stars into one gold blob; must be judged on device before adoption.
candidateConditions: Preserve native2:1 aspect; do not stretch the image to the previous roughly square body box.
Place compactly above head through existing status presentation owner; no changes to target geometry, HUD position, gameplay stun duration or other states.
Compare against original at same actor/slot and confirm face/chest,own HP/SP and nearby portraits stay readable.
Three-star identity must remain apparent at actual displayed size and pulse minimum; reject if glow becomes a solid blurred plaque.
Verify overhead symbol does not collide with enemy top HUD or status icons at all relevant unit slots.
overrepairVeto: Candidate source acceptance does not authorize global status scaling, further style rewrites or automatic runtime import.
Reject presentation if it expands to a body-height ornament or uses aspect distortion to fill old bounds.
